title: Add multi-route reachability diagnostics and leak-safe modes
author: w0F5vYijNonu8kkqLSa_jYY4GIV-Q5HpbxYY525ggm4

events.title: Add multi-route reachability diagnostics and leak-safe modes
events.body:
## Outcome

Configure and diagnose direct, proxy, overlay, and LAN-only repository routes without silently exposing a direct network path.

## Implementation

- Define route adapters with address, remote-name-resolution, authentication reference, expected privacy mode, and priority.
- Probe each route for reachability, latency, clone capability, last success, and a sanitized failure reason.
- Support proxy-only and LAN-only modes that disable direct DNS resolution and direct sockets at the lowest shared transport layer.
- Allow simultaneous route publication while making the selected route and any fallback policy explicit.
- Expose route health through one contract consumed by desktop, browser, headless health, and #466.

## Acceptance criteria

- Proxy-only and LAN-only leak tests observe no direct DNS query or socket attempt.
- No route silently falls back to a less private mode.
- Authentication material and full private addresses never enter diagnostics.
- Health changes update live without restarting the node.
- A stock Git clone uses the selected healthy route or returns its exact bounded failure reason.

## Dependencies

Nearby discovery and peer streams are added in #472; availability consumes this contract in #466.

## Verification

Run simultaneous healthy, slow, failed, misconfigured, credential-rejected, name-resolution, proxy-only, LAN-only, and explicit-fallback route fixtures with socket-level leak assertions.
